stackDivergence.rationale: Task75 preserves the original token family and genuine owned values/reference operations, with explicit erased C++ type/category/access witnesses. Existing SAL atomics, OUString, SharedString, FormulaError, OpCode and ParamClass are reused. Ordinary unchanged full headers and complete selected member definitions compile over real SAL/Boost dependencies; whole initialized native streams and complete affected raw100/source-absent checks provide bounded evidence. Broad module parity flags remain unverified. Full tokenarray/compiler/Calc cell/matrix/document/input/view/UI, native physical ABI, invalid object casts/lifetimes, concurrent execution, debug process termination and complete upstream QA remain unfinished or unverified. No fake Calc/compiler/pointee class, alternate engine, threshold change or routine sanitizer is introduced. Next full81.
